Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.
  
  
Tenstorrent is hiring a Senior Data Security Engineer to lead data security posture management (DSPM), data loss prevention (DLP), AI data governance, and technical export-control enforcement across our SaaS estate, cloud, AI pipelines, and silicon engineering filesystems. As a senior member of the Operations Security (OpSec) team reporting to the Head of Information Security, you will protect our RISC-V and AI silicon IP, customer-confidential programs, and export-controlled data without slowing engineering down. This is a hands-on role for a data security engineer who builds their own tooling.
  
  
This role is remote, based out of the United States or Canada.
  
  
We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.
  
  
**Who You Are**

- A DSPM/DLP specialist across Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub/GitLab, and AWS who writes code to fill the gaps off-the-shelf tools leave.
- AI-native: you use coding agents and LLMs to build tools and reports, and you design the guardrails that keep credentials and IP out of unauthorized models.
- Able to turn export-control rules (EAR, CMMC) and customer confidentiality agreements into enforceable identity groups and access controls.
- Pragmatic and high-signal, favoring high-confidence controls over noisy rules that frustrate engineers.

**What We Need**

- Deep experience designing and running DSPM and DLP controls across Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and AWS to stop unauthorized sharing and exfiltration.
- Strong grasp of AI security posture management: governing what data flows into AI tools, inference providers, and autonomous agents.
- Programming and automation skills (Python, TypeScript, or Go, plus Terraform and Docker) to build classification and permission-reconciliation pipelines.
- Experience with networked filesystems (NFS, SMB, AD/POSIX ACLs) and translating export-control boundaries into identity pipelines through Entra ID and Active Directory.
- Experience securing backups (immutability, customer-managed encryption) and running live disaster recovery drills with SRE.

**What You Will Learn**

- How to architect export-control data boundaries and confidential project enclaves for RISC-V processors and AI accelerators.
- How to build AI-native DLP and data classification pipelines across agent workflows and LLM gateways.
- How to lead end-to-end disaster recovery validation across source control, PKI, virtualization clusters, and endpoint fleets.
- How to turn complex permission and data-posture audits into repeatable automation using Tenstorrent's internal AI tooling.

*Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.*
*Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.*
*This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.*

Every open role at venture-backed companies that closed a round in the last six months, from pre-seed through Series C and beyond. Right now that is about 19,000 jobs at roughly 900 startups.

Why recent rounds? A company that just raised has fresh runway, a hiring plan and a reason to move fast. Most startup job boards mix in companies that last raised years ago. JustBacked only shows teams with new money in the bank.

How it works:
- Jobs are read every morning straight from each company's own hiring system (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and about 20 more). No recruiters, no staffing agencies, no reposts from other boards. Closed roles drop off the next day.
- Every role shows the round behind it: stage, amount, lead investors and when it closed.
- Filter by role, city, remote, funding stage, investor or industry. For example: remote engineering jobs at Series A startups, or every opening at companies a16z backed this year.
- Pay is shown when the company publishes it.
- A weekly Funded & Hiring report lists the startups that raised that week and what they are hiring for.

Works with AI assistants: connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client to search roles, research companies, draft application answers and keep a tracker. You always submit applications yourself.

Browse free. Members ($12/month or $59/year) see new roles the day they are posted and get alerts.

**Own the controls that protect sensitive data across the enterprise, with a primary focus on Microsoft Purview.**

  

As a **Senior Security Engineer** at Resmed, you will design, implement, and continuously improve data security controls, primarily across Microsoft 365. Your work will strengthen how sensitive information is classified, shared, retained, monitored, and protected, helping Resmed meet business, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements. You will bring hands-on expertise in **Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Information Protection, and data loss prevention**, while working hands-on with security controls and collaborating with teams responsible for the Microsoft 365 platform. 

  

This is a highly collaborative role within **a global enterprise security team**. You will work across IT, Legal, Risk, Security Operations, and platform teams to translate business and security requirements into practical, sustainable controls and progress agreed Data Security initiatives that protect data throughout its lifecycle. 

  

**What You’ll Do**

- Design, engineer, configure, and maintain Microsoft Purview controls, working with platform owners where required, including Microsoft Information Protection, sensitivity labels, rights management, encryption, retention, and information governance policies.

- Implement, test, and tune DLP controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing.

- Contribute to engineering and implementation activities involving broader Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) controls, including identifying sensitive data exposure risks and implementing appropriate protection measures.

- Assess Microsoft 365 security baselines and recommend improvements across enterprise collaboration services.

- Manage and validate external sharing, guest access, and third-party collaboration controls.

- Monitor compliance posture, investigate trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Support audits and regulatory reviews by gathering evidence, maintaining documentation, and producing accurate reports.

- Engage with IT, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Security Operations, and platform teams to understand requirements, provide technical guidance, and implement effective data protection controls.

- Support delivery of assigned Enterprise Security Data Security initiatives under the direction of Security leadership, coordinating stakeholders and completing hands-on engineering deliverables.

- Translate stakeholder and business requirements into technical security requirements, working with relevant teams to agree practical implementation approaches.

- Participate in incident response, investigations, and post-incident reviews involving information protection and data exposure.

- Automate policy deployment, reporting, and repeatable security processes using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API where appropriate.

- Integrate relevant Microsoft 365 security signals with SIEM capabilities for monitoring and incident correlation.

- Stay current with Microsoft 365 security and compliance developments, emerging threats, and evolving data protection standards.

  

**What You Bring**

- At least three to five years of hands-on security engineering experience in enterprise environments, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 information protection, DLP, or data governance.

- Practical experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Microsoft Information Protection policies, sensitivity labels, rights management, and encryption controls.

- Experience developing, implementing, and refining DLP policies across Microsoft 365 collaboration services and endpoints, with exposure to broader DLP controls desirable.

- Working knowledge of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) concepts and capabilities, including sensitive data discovery, exposure risk identification, and remediation.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview capabilities, including Data Lifecycle Management, Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, and Information Governance.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Entra governance and conditional access integrations.

- Experience working with Generative AI technologies, with an understanding of associated Data Security risks, including sensitive data exposure, unauthorized data sharing, and shadow AI.

- Experience troubleshooting complex security control issues and working with platform owners or technology vendors to resolve implementation challenges.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business and technical stakeholders, communicate technical recommendations, and progress assigned security engineering initiatives.

- Experience managing external sharing, guest access, and third-party data access controls.

- Ability to align technical controls with relevant frameworks and regulations, including ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, GDPR, HIPAA, CIS, and the Australian Privacy Act.

- Experience supporting compliance operations, incident management, or data governance in a regulated or high-assurance environment.

- SC-401 certification and a bachelor’s degree are preferred.

  

***Nice to have:***

- SC-200 or SC-900 certification.

- CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certification.

  

**What Sets You Apart**

- **Analytical judgment:** You turn complex business and compliance requirements into clear, workable security controls.

- **Constructive courage:** You challenge ineffective approaches, explain the risk, and make a well-supported case for change.

- **Collaborative influence:** You build alignment across technical and non-technical teams without losing sight of security outcomes.

- **Clear communication:** You make complex data protection topics understandable and document decisions with care.

- **Continuous improvement:** You look for practical ways to strengthen policies, automate repeatable work, and improve the compliance posture.

- **Global mindset:** You collaborate effectively across regions and time zones while respecting different perspectives and operating needs.

Since 2012, Rightsline has been making work easier for rights and royalties professionals with our innovative rights and royalties management software, allowing our customers to maximize their portfolios without having to max out their daily to-do-lists.

Our fully integrated and configurable platform provides customers with comprehensive access to all their rights and royalties, across all markets and platforms, instantly. Departments can communicate, collaborate, and cohesively take action without worrying about mistakes; and in-app reports and timely alerts ensure our customers never miss an opportunity to do more.

## **The Position**

The GTM Data Engineer / AI is the technical architect behind Rightsline’s revenue intelligence engine. This role builds robust, low-latency data pipelines connecting go-to-market systems, automates inbound and outbound enrichment workflows, and engineers production-grade AI agents that improve rep productivity, speed-to-lead, and pipeline conversion. The role is based in the Greater Toronto Area in a hybrid work environment and reports to the Head of Revenue Operations.

## **Mission & Impact**

Build reliable, scalable GTM data and AI infrastructure that equips commercial teams with timely intelligence and automated workflows. Success will be measured by fast lead routing, comprehensive enrichment, highly available pipelines, and reduced seller research time.

## **What You Will Own**

## **GTM Data Pipeline Architecture**

- *Design, build, and maintain high-reliability data models, pipelines, and synchronization jobs using SQL, Python/TypeScript, and APIs across Salesforce, Clay, Gong, and ZoomInfo.*

## **Production AI Automation & Agent Orchestration**

- *Develop and deploy autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI workflows that research incoming leads, parse conversational context from Gong, summarize account intent, and trigger tailored actions.*

## **Enrichment Loops & Speed-to-Lead**

- *Engineer automated multi-source enrichment tables in Clay, integrating intent signals, technographic data, and company hiring signals directly into rep workflows.*
- *Build automated webhook listeners and distribution logic to enrich, score, and route inbound demo requests and product signals to reps in under 5 minutes.*

## **Internal Tool Ownership & AI Governance**

- *Serve as technical product owner for in-house GTM tools and custom API integrations, ensuring resilient error handling, retry logic, and monitoring.*
- *Partner with the Head of Revenue Operations to evaluate emerging LLM capabilities, establish guardrails around data privacy and brand compliance, and advise commercial leaders on high-ROI AI use cases.*

## **Key Deliverables & Technical KPIs**

- *Speed-to-Lead: Complete inbound lead enrichment and delivery in under 5 minutes.*
- *Lead Enrichment Completeness: Achieve greater than 95% automated coverage of key technographic and firmographic data points.*
- *Data Pipeline Reliability: Maintain greater than 99.5% pipeline uptime with automated alerting and failover.*
- *Rep Time Saved: Reduce seller administrative research time by an estimated 3 to 5 hours per week per rep.*

## **Technical Boundary & Clean Handoff**

Own external data extraction, pipeline transformation, API connectors, and AI agent execution. Consume normalized schema from the GTM Systems Owner (Role 2) and programmatically enrich data without making unmanaged, unilateral changes to core CRM validation rules or permissions.

## **What You Will Bring**

- *4+ years of data engineering, systems integration, or technical Revenue Operations experience within modern B2B SaaS technology stacks.*
- *Strong proficiency with Python or TypeScript, API architecture, webhooks, and relational data modeling (SQL / dbt).*
- *Hands-on mastery of modern enrichment and orchestration tools (Clay, Zapier/Make, Gong, ZoomInfo) and CRM APIs.*
- *Demonstrated experience building and evaluating practical LLM/AI agent workflows in production business environments.*
- *Strong business acumen and understanding of B2B SaaS revenue funnels (MQL SQL Opportunity Closed-Won).*

## **Our Core Values**

At Rightsline, we look for these qualities in every hire, and we hold ourselves to them every day.

- ## **Be Curious and Smart**

*Being smart isn't about having all the answers — it's about asking the right questions, seeking out new ideas, and never assuming you already know enough.*

- ## **Embrace Change**

*This industry moves fast and so do we. We don't resist change — we lean into it. That means staying flexible, letting go of what isn't working, and treating uncertainty as opportunity rather than obstacle.*

- ## **Show Up**

*Showing up means being present — not just physically, but mentally and emotionally. Your teammates count on you. Your customers count on you. We do our best work when everyone is fully engaged and accountable to each other.*

- ## **Get it Done**

*Ideas are easy. Execution is the job. We hold ourselves to what we commit to, push through the hard parts, and measure success by our actual accomplishments.*

- ## **Be Humble**

*Nobody here has a monopoly on good ideas. We listen more than we talk, share credit freely, and check our egos at the door. The best outcome matters more than whose idea it was.*

## **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Rightsline is an equal opportunity workplace. All candidates will be afforded equal opportunity through the recruiting process. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity and/or expression. We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented individuals and creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.

If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know.

## **Apply Today**

If you want to join a company that strives for a mission, purpose and making an impact, we encourage you to apply today.

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. **ABOUT The Ipsos DataHub**

The Ipsos DataHub is a uniquely positioned group within Ipsos. It is a next-generation data platform designed to unlock the full value of data across the organization. By bringing together information, technology, and expertise in a seamless and secure ecosystem, it empowers teams to move faster, think bigger, and deliver deeper, more meaningful insights. DataHub is at the heart of Ipsos’ vision to transform how data drives decisions, innovation, and impact for clients worldwide. 

We’re looking for someone with a deep interest and expertise in data engineering and the dedication to apply that passion. We need someone with the technical expertise to expand and optimize our existing data pipeline and architecture. The ideal candidate will have experience using cloud-based platforms, like Google Cloud Services and AWS, to build and maintain serverless data pipelines to efficiently process and warehouse large scale datasets. The role also requires conscientious attention to detail, an ability to work well on a small team, and a self-starter approach to problem solving and debugging.

**What you can expect to be doing:**

- Design and optimize data warehouses and distributed data systems for scalability, security, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
- Provide hands-on technical leadership through solution design, code reviews, debugging, production support, and mentorship of data engineers.

- Proficiency in Python and advanced working knowledge of SQL.

- Prior success designing, deploying, and operating large-scale data pipelines and distributed storage/compute systems in production environments.
- Strong understanding of production failure modes, performance tuning, capacity planning, data quality, and disaster-recovery/recoverability concepts.
- Experience with collaboration tools (e.g. Atlassian suite) and version control systems (e.g. Git).
- Experience incorporating AI/LLM-based tools into data engineering workflows, with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate outputs and apply sound engineering judgment to accept, adapt, or reject suggestions.
- Strong technical communication skills and the ability to explain complex engineering concepts, influence technical decisions, and work effectively in a highly collaborative, consensus-oriented environment.
- Strong attention to detail, excellent time-management skills, and a track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team.

**Ingénieur principal de données (Senior Data Engineer)**

**Description du poste**

**Principales responsabilités**

**1. Architecture de la plateforme et ingénierie des données**

- Concevoir, développer et maintenir des solutions de données dans Microsoft Fabric, en respectant le cadre architectural et les normes de la plateforme de données du client.
- Mettre en œuvre et optimiser l'architecture médaillon (Medallion Architecture), notamment les couches Bronze, Silver et Gold.
- Contribuer à l'évolution et à l'amélioration de la plateforme de données d'entreprise, incluant les lacs de données (Data Lakes) et les entrepôts de données (Data Warehouses).
- Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données performants à l'aide de SQL, Python, Apache Spark et d'autres technologies de traitement de données massives, telles que Kafka et Hadoop.
- Développer des processus fiables et évolutifs pour l'ingestion, la transformation, le traitement et la distribution de données provenant de diverses sources.
- Intégrer des données issues de systèmes internes, de plateformes externes et de dispositifs de l'Internet des objets (IoT) afin de répondre aux besoins opérationnels et analytiques de l'organisation.
- Développer et maintenir des solutions de données en arrière-plan (backend) permettant de répondre aux besoins des analystes de données, des scientifiques de données et des autres utilisateurs d'affaires.

**2. Exploitation, qualité et livraison des solutions de données**

- Mettre en œuvre les pratiques DevOps afin d'améliorer les processus de développement, de test, de déploiement et de maintenance des solutions de données.
- Identifier les possibilités d'automatisation des tâches manuelles et optimiser les processus de traitement et de livraison des données.
- Veiller au respect des normes et des bonnes pratiques en matière de gouvernance, d'architecture, de qualité et de sécurité des données.
- Surveiller la performance et la fiabilité des pipelines de données, diagnostiquer les problèmes et mettre en œuvre les correctifs nécessaires.
- Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme afin d'en assurer la stabilité, la performance, la sécurité et l'évolutivité.

**3. Collaboration et leadership technique**

- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de produits, les spécialistes des données, les architectes de solutions et les autres parties prenantes afin de comprendre les besoins et de proposer des solutions techniques adaptées.
- Participer aux décisions relatives à l'architecture, à la conception et à l'évolution de la plateforme de données.
- Effectuer des revues de code, contribuer activement au développement de solutions et veiller au respect des normes de programmation et des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie.
- Fournir un encadrement technique et partager son expertise avec les membres de l'équipe afin de favoriser le développement des compétences et le transfert des connaissances.
- Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires dans le cadre de projets et d'initiatives liés aux données, à l'analytique avancée et à l'intelligence artificielle.

**Qualifications minimales requises**

- Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie logiciel, en génie informatique ou dans un domaine connexe. Une maîtrise constitue un atout.
- Minimum de six (6) années d'expérience en ingénierie des données, avec une solide expérience pratique en développement et en programmation.
- Excellente maîtrise de Python, Apache Spark, SQL et des langages de script connexes.
- Expérience pratique avec Visual Studio Code (VS Code) et Git dans un environnement moderne de développement logiciel.

Expérience pratique obligatoire avec Microsoft Fabric, notamment :

- Lakehouses (lacs de données).
- OneLake.
- Pipelines de données.
- Notebooks.
- Architecture médaillon (Medallion Architecture), incluant les couches Bronze, Silver et Gold.
- Excellente compréhension des principes fondamentaux de l'informatique, notamment les structures de données, les algorithmes et les principes de résolution de problèmes.
- Expérience pratique avec Terraform et les principes d'infrastructure en tant que code (Infrastructure as Code – IaC).
- Expérience avec les bases de données relationnelles et non relationnelles (NoSQL), notamment Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL et Azure Cosmos DB.

**Qualifications et compétences considérées comme des atouts**

**Une expérience avec les technologies et outils suivants sera considérée comme un avantage :**

Intégration et orchestration des données

This is a hands-on role for a data security engineer who builds their own tooling.

This role is remote, based out of the United States or Canada.

**About The Team**
The AI & Data Platform team builds the foundation that makes Vantage's retail media platform intelligent. We own the data platform that turns campaign activity across onsite, offsite, and in-store channels into the trusted reporting that retailers and brands rely on to understand what their advertising delivers. And we're building Vantage's AI platform: the intelligent systems, automation, and workflows that help advertisers scale their operations, and the foundation that lets every team at Vantage bring agents into the product safely.
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role you'll focus on building and evolving the data platform behind Vantage's reporting and the AI platform that lets teams build agents on top of it, while acting as a subject matter expert and mentor for our engineering team. Expect heavy use of external APIs and data feeds to pull data from ad platforms and partner systems, as well as designing and delivering pipelines, data models, and agent-facing services that other teams at Vantage depend on. You'll work with large datasets, perform hands-on coding, and keep our pipelines and services reliable, and fast.
  
  
In this role you'll be called on to support multiple product teams to uphold sound architecture, high code quality, and on-time delivery across both halves of what we own. On the data side, you'll be a trusted go-to reviewer for SQL, dbt, and data model changes, and set clear standards for warehouse performance and data trust. On the AI side, you'll shape the intelligent systems and automated workflows advertisers rely on inside Vantage and how other teams build agents on our platform: which tools an agent can call, how it reaches data securely, and whether the answer it gives actually solves the customer's problem. We're a platform team, but we measure ourselves by what our customers can do with what we build. You'll talk to the people who use it, care about whether it delights them, and guide design and trade-off decisions that keep the platform scalable while solving real problems.
  
  
This posting is for an existing vacancy (backfill).
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

- 6+ years of professional experience with a strong record in software development, testing, software design, and architecture.
- Advanced SQL expertise: comfortable reading query plans, designing data models, tuning complex joins and aggregations, and refactoring queries for reliability and speed on large datasets.
- Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse and a transformation framework such as dbt, including dimensional modelling (star schema or medallion architectures).
- Experience building with LLMs in production: agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph or LangChain), tool use, and protocols such as MCP, with an understanding of how to give agents secure, scoped access to data.
- Experience as a gatekeeper for data quality and query performance in code reviews and debugging sessions, with a demonstrated ability to both diagnose and prevent issues.
- Proven ability to troubleshoot and debug production pipelines and services using logs, metrics, and traces.
- Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, and CI/CD tooling such as CircleCI or GitHub Actions.
- Experience with B2B API and data integrations, and with relational databases such as MySQL or Postgres.
- Track record of effective mentoring and knowledge sharing.
- Nice to have: Experience with Snowflake and streaming data systems, or with managed LLM platforms, evals, and guardrails. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is a plus.

**Role Responsibilities**

- Own data platform performance and quality. Review pull requests with an eye for query cost, data model design, test coverage, and freshness, and drive improvements across the warehouse.
- Own data ingestion and integrations. Build and maintain reliable connectors to ad platforms and partner systems, including authentication, rate limiting, and retries, and define how other Vantage teams land data on the platform.
- Design and ship transformation pipelines and data models in SQL, dbt, and Python that turn raw data into trusted, query-ready datasets with predictable latency and high reliability.
- Build and evolve the AI platform: agent-facing services and MCP tools that expose data to agents with per-user identity and access controls, and the shared patterns other teams use to build their own agents on Vantage.
- Diagnose production issues, lead debugging sessions, and improve observability using logs, metrics, and traces. Proactively identify performance, cost, and data-quality risks and coach the team on preventing regressions, backed by strong automated tests and clear documentation.
- Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews, and actionable feedback, and stay close to the people who use what we build: advertisers scaling their operations on our automation, product teams querying the data, and engineers building agents on the platform. Bring their problems into architectural decisions so the platform scales and solves real customer needs.

**About Vantage**
Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. With a global presence in North America and Asia-Pacific, Vantage enables retailers to launch and grow their media networks through scalable technology and automated workflows, and is trusted by leading retailers like The Home Depot to power their retail media programs.
  
  
For a closer look at what we do, our culture, and our benefits, check out our about us and careers pages.
  
  
**Remote-First, Based in Toronto**
Vantage is proudly headquartered in Toronto, but we’re a remote-first team spread across North America (and beyond). Our flexible work philosophy means team members can thrive from wherever they do their best work—whether that’s from a home office, a local café, or while adding stamps to their passport. With a remote-friendly setup, home office support, and annual company retreats, we stay connected, collaborative, and energized—no matter the time zone.
  
  
**Vantage’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
Vantage Analytics is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment. We encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.
  
  
We promote equality and strive to provide all current and prospective employees with support and opportunities. Reasonable accommodations are available to job applicants on request and throughout the application process.
  
  
**How Vantage Uses AI In The Recruitment Process**
At Vantage, we use AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. This may include using AI to help organize, screen, and assess applications. We are committed to using these tools responsibly, and ensuring every candidate is treated fairly throughout the process.
  
  
All hiring decisions at Vantage are made by our team. Who we invite to work at Vantage is a decision we only trust ourselves to make.
  
  
**What's Next?**
We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
As part of the final stages of our hiring process, all candidates will be required to successfully complete a criminal background check.

The

Cross-Functional Partnership

**Own the controls that protect sensitive data across the enterprise, with a primary focus on Microsoft Purview.**

  

As a **Senior Security Engineer** at Resmed, you will design, implement, and continuously improve data security controls, primarily across Microsoft 365. Your work will strengthen how sensitive information is classified, shared, retained, monitored, and protected, helping Resmed meet business, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements. You will bring hands-on expertise in **Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Information Protection, and data loss prevention** , while working hands-on with security controls and collaborating with teams responsible for the Microsoft 365 platform.

  

This is a highly collaborative role within **a global enterprise security team** . You will work across IT, Legal, Risk, Security Operations, and platform teams to translate business and security requirements into practical, sustainable controls and progress agreed Data Security initiatives that protect data throughout its lifecycle.

  

**What You’ll Do**

- Design, engineer, configure, and maintain Microsoft Purview controls, working with platform owners where required, including Microsoft Information Protection, sensitivity labels, rights management, encryption, retention, and information governance policies.

- Implement, test, and tune DLP controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing.

- Contribute to engineering and implementation activities involving broader Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) controls, including identifying sensitive data exposure risks and implementing appropriate protection measures.

- Assess Microsoft 365 security baselines and recommend improvements across enterprise collaboration services.

- Manage and validate external sharing, guest access, and third-party collaboration controls.

- Monitor compliance posture, investigate trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Support audits and regulatory reviews by gathering evidence, maintaining documentation, and producing accurate reports.

- Engage with IT, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Security Operations, and platform teams to understand requirements, provide technical guidance, and implement effective data protection controls.

- Support delivery of assigned Enterprise Security Data Security initiatives under the direction of Security leadership, coordinating stakeholders and completing hands-on engineering deliverables.

- Translate stakeholder and business requirements into technical security requirements, working with relevant teams to agree practical implementation approaches.

- Participate in incident response, investigations, and post-incident reviews involving information protection and data exposure.

- Automate policy deployment, reporting, and repeatable security processes using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API where appropriate.

- Integrate relevant Microsoft 365 security signals with SIEM capabilities for monitoring and incident correlation.

Stay current with Microsoft 365 security and compliance developments, emerging threats, and evolving data protection standards.  

  

**What You Bring**

- At least three to five years of hands-on security engineering experience in enterprise environments, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 information protection, DLP, or data governance.

- Practical experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Microsoft Information Protection policies, sensitivity labels, rights management, and encryption controls.

- Experience developing, implementing, and refining DLP policies across Microsoft 365 collaboration services and endpoints, with exposure to broader DLP controls desirable.

- Working knowledge of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) concepts and capabilities, including sensitive data discovery, exposure risk identification, and remediation.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Entra governance and conditional access integrations.

- Experience working with Generative AI technologies, with an understanding of associated Data Security risks, including sensitive data exposure, unauthorized data sharing, and shadow AI.

- Experience managing external sharing, guest access, and third-party data access controls.

- Ability to align technical controls with relevant frameworks and regulations, including ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, GDPR, HIPAA, CIS, and the Australian Privacy Act.

- Experience supporting compliance operations, incident management, or data governance in a regulated or high-assurance environment.

SC-401 certification and a bachelor’s degree are preferred.  

  

***Nice to have:***

- SC-200 or SC-900 certification.

CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certification.  

  

**What Sets You Apart**

- **Constructive courage:** You challenge ineffective approaches, explain the risk, and make a well-supported case for change.

**Overview**  

**ENGLISH TEXT FOLLOWS FRENCH**

**Aperçu du poste**

En accord avec nos valeurs Microsoft, nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de travail inclusif pour tous les employés afin d'avoir un impact positif sur notre culture chaque jour, et nous avons besoin de vous comme **ingénieur(e) électrique de centres de données en environnement critique.**

Le Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) de Microsoft est le moteur qui alimente nos services cloud. En tant qu'ingénieur(e) électrique CO+I, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise en œuvre de l'infrastructure de base et des technologies de base pour les services en ligne de Microsoft, notamment Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive et la plateforme Microsoft Azure. En groupe, CO+I se concentre sur le développement personnel et professionnel de tous les employés et offre des formations et des opportunités de croissance, incluant des programmes de rotation de carrière, des formations et événements en diversité et inclusion, ainsi que des certifications professionnelles.

Notre infrastructure est composée d'un vaste portefeuille mondial de plus de 200 centres de données dans 32 pays et de millions de serveurs. Notre base est bâtie et gérée par une équipe d'experts spécialisés travaillant pour soutenir les services de plus d'un milliard de clients et de 20 millions d'entreprises dans plus de 90 pays à travers le monde.

Avec la durabilité environnementale et l'optimisation au cœur de la conception et des opérations de notre centre de données, nous continuons de croître et d'évoluer à mesure que nous répondons aux exigences commerciales en constante évolution qui font de Microsoft un fournisseur cloud de classe mondiale.

La mission de Microsoft est d'autonomiser chaque personne et chaque organisation sur la planète pour accomplir davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous réunissons avec un esprit de croissance, innovons pour autonomiser les autres et collaborons pour réaliser nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous bâtons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où tout le monde peut s'épanouir au travail et au-delà.

**Responsabilités**

***Conception***

- Développer des connaissances de base sur les tendances de l'industrie, les produits des concurrents, l'expérience client et les avancées dans divers domaines de l'ingénierie. Consulter d'autres ingénieurs pour aider à comprendre et appliquer des concepts avancés.
- Aider à la création et à l'exécution de conceptions et/ou de plans de vérification robustes, évolutifs, sécurisés et extensibles pour les aspects de génie électrique d'une fonctionnalité ou d'une extension de produit bien définie (par exemple, un rafraîchissement de produit ou une extension de ligne).
- Participer à la création de propriété intellectuelle. Pouvoir déposer des brevets dans le domaine d'application personnel et compléter la documentation de brevet nécessaire.
- Mettre en œuvre des solutions connues aux défis techniques et/ou de conception courants, avec quelques conseils d'autres ingénieurs.
- Lire les fiches techniques de l'appareil et interpréter les détails courants nécessaires pour concevoir et tester diverses fonctionnalités matérielles.
- Élaborer une documentation de conception pouvant inclure des dessins, des spécifications, des schémas ou des diagrammes pour les caractéristiques de produits bien définis, avec l'accompagnement et l'orientation d'un gestionnaire ou d'autres ingénieurs.
- Examiner les fiches techniques des fournisseurs ou partenaires pour les pièces disponibles et choisir les pièces appropriées nécessaires pour soutenir le développement du produit.

***Tests et vérification***

- S’assurer que les exigences de test sont incluses dans la documentation et les spécifications d'une fonctionnalité ou d'un produit.
- Déterminer l'équipement de test approprié (par exemple, oscilloscopes, analyseurs de spectre, analyseurs logiques) pour mesurer une caractéristique d'un produit selon les plans de vérification existants, avec une supervision minimale d'autres ingénieurs.
- Rédiger des cas de test de vérification de conception en utilisant des modèles standards et des méthodologies de test.
- Développer, examiner et exécuter des plans de test et/ou une infrastructure pour les fonctionnalités ou produits standards.
- Aider à développer des solutions de tests automatisées et effectuer de façon autonome des tests automatisés sur des zones de fonctionnalités ou des produits standards.
- Rassembler des données pour les options de sélection externes de fournisseurs ou de partenaires.
- Aider à mettre en place et à décomposer les environnements de test avec l'accompagnement et la supervision d'autres ingénieurs. Suivre les directives de sécurité.
- Participer à l'élaboration de tableaux de bord ou de rapports pour les tests et les indicateurs de qualité pouvant être utilisés pour caractériser le matériel et la performance matérielle.
- Analyser et interpréter les résultats des données et des analyses statistiques afin d'identifier les problèmes ou défauts courants pouvant affecter un changement de fonctionnalité ou de conception de produit et les porter à l'attention d'autres ingénieurs ou chefs d'équipe.
- Aider au développement de supports de test de base pour les tests ou la validation de nouvelles fonctionnalités du produit sous la supervision d'autres ingénieurs.

***Mise en œuvre du projet technique***

- Suivre les calendriers de mise en œuvre du projet pour fournir les aspects d'ingénierie matérielle d'une fonctionnalité ou d'un produit bien défini. Escalader les problèmes à la gestion au besoin.
- Mettre en œuvre et suivre les plans de produit, sous la guidance d'autres ingénieurs.
- Mettre en lumière les problèmes potentiels qui pourraient affecter l'exécution en aval des projets (p. ex. performance versus fiabilité et préoccupations liées à la fabrication).
- Se renseigner sur de nouveaux outils, technologies ou processus pour la mise en œuvre du projet et fournissez des rapports aux membres de l'équipe de projet.
- Aider à intégrer les évaluations des risques (par exemple, retards liés aux fournisseurs ou partenaires, spécifications incomplètes ou problèmes d'outils) dans les plans de projet.
- Communiquer l'avancement/l'état du projet au sein de l'équipe de projet et escaladez les problèmes au besoin.

***Rapports et documentation***

- Suivre les procédures établies pour participer à la création de rapports détaillés et de spécifications fonctionnelles pour une fonctionnalité ou une extension de produit bien définie, basées sur des audits et des informations issues des processus de développement et de vérification du produit.
- Documenter les détails essentiels concernant les matériaux, composants et/ou assemblages d'un dispositif selon les processus de libération acceptés. Enregistrer et suivre avec précision les modifications des conceptions selon les processus établis, avec quelques conseils d'autres ingénieurs.

***Autres***

- Incarner notre [culture](https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/ca/fr/culture) et nos [valeurs](https://www.microsoft.com/fr-ca/about/values).

**Qualifications requises/minimales**

- Maîtrise en génie électrique, génie informatique ou domaine connexe ET 1+ an d'expérience en génie technique OU baccalauréat en génie électrique, génie informatique ou domaine connexe ET 2+ ans d'expérience en génie technique OU expérience équivalente.
- Chez Microsoft, vous travaillerez de manière intégrée avec des collègues à travers le monde. Afin de faciliter cette collaboration, la maîtrise de la communication orale et écrite en anglais et en français est requise pour ce rôle.
- Être membre en règle de l'Ordre des ingénieurs du Québec (OIQ), être candidat(e) à la profession d'ingénieur (CPI) ou être admissible à l'adhésion à l'OIQ.

**Exigences pour la vérification des antécédents :**

Ce rôle exige la capacité de répondre aux exigences en matière de filtrage de sécurité des Microsoft, des clients et/ou du gouvernement. Ces exigences comprennent, sans toutefois s'y limiter, les enquêtes de sécurité spécialisées suivantes :

- Le candidat retenu doit actuellement être en mesure d'obtenir une cote de fiabilité auprès d'un ministère ou d'un organisme dûment autorisé du gouvernement du Canada. Ce processus comprend, sans s'y limiter:

- La vérification de l'identité, des antécédents, de la scolarité, des titres professionnels, des références personnelles et professionnelles, ainsi qu'une vérification de crédit et une vérification des antécédents criminels.
- La cote de fiabilité peut également exiger un questionnaire de sécurité et une entrevue de sécurité.

**Job overview**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **Critical Environment Data Center Electrical Engineer.**

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Electrical Engineer, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

***Design***

- Develop basic knowledge of industry trends, competitors' products, customer experience, and advances in various engineering fields. Consult with other engineers to help understand and apply advanced concepts.
- Assist in the creation and execution of robust, scalable, secure, and extensible designs and/or verification plans for the electrical engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product extension (e.g., a product refresh, or line extension).
- Participate in creating intellectual property. May file patents within personal area of scope and complete necessary patent documentation.
- Implement known solutions to common technical and/or design challenges, with some guidance from other engineers.
- Read device specification sheets and interpret common details required to design and test various hardware features.
- Develop design documentation which could include drawings, specifications, schematics, or diagrams for features of well-defined products with guidance and direction from a manager or other engineers.
- Review supplier or partner technical sheets for available parts and choose appropriate parts needed to support product development.

***Testing and Verification***

- Ensure that test requirements are included in documentation and specifications for a feature or product.
- Determine the appropriate test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) for measuring a feature of a product according to existing verification plans, with minimal supervision from other engineers.
- Write design verification test cases using standard templates and test methodologies.
- Develop, review, and execute test plans and/or infrastructure for standard features or products.
- Assist in developing automated testing solutions and independently conduct automated testing on standard feature areas or products.
- Gather data for external testing supplier or partner selection options.
- Assist in setting up and breaking down testing environments with guidance and supervision from other engineers. Follow safety guidelines.
- Participate in the development of dashboards or reports for testing and quality metrics that can be utilized to characterize hardware and hardware performance.
- Analyze and interpret results of data and statistical analyses to identify common problems or flaws that may affect a feature or product design change and bring them to the attention of other engineers or team leads.
- Assist in the development of basic test fixtures for use in testing or validation of new product features under guidance from other engineers.

***Technical Project Implementation***

- Follow project implementation schedules to deliver the hardware engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product. Escalate issues to management as necessary.
- Implement and track product plans, under guidance from other engineers.
- Highlight potential issues that may affect downstream execution of projects (e.g., performance vs. reliability and manufacturing concerns).
- Research new tools, technologies, or processes for project implementation and provide reports to project team members.
- Assist in implementing risk assessments (e.g., supplier or partner delays, incomplete specs, or tool issues) into project plans.
- Communicate project progress/status within the project team and escalate issues as necessary.

***Reporting and Documentation***

- Follow established procedures to participate in creating detailed reports and functional specifications for a well-defined product feature or extension, based on audits and information from product development and verification processes.
- Document essential details about materials, components, and/or assemblies for a device via accepted release processes. Accurately record and track changes to designs following established processes with some guidance from other engineers.

***Other***

- Embody the Microsoft One [culture](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcareers.microsoft.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fculture&data=04%7C01%7Closmit%40microsoft.com%7C27f2181d96804234953708d8f3b22d06%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C637527293867872556%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C1000&sdata=QnmEU%2BvawaPM5eEUL1FxWPmhizgKnDLFj6dlUTOWRB0%3D&reserved=0) and [values](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.microsoft.com%2Fen-us%2Fabout%2Fcorporate-values&data=04%7C01%7Closmit%40microsoft.com%7C27f2181d96804234953708d8f3b22d06%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C637527293867882502%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C1000&sdata=p3lkWaIXzH3t9t1hS9bOfKhtDFWPj6gi8zZU94LWRso%3D&reserved=0).

  
  
**Qualifications**  

### Required/minimum qualifications

- Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.
- At Microsoft, you will be working in an integrated fashion with colleagues around the world. To facilitate this collaboration, proficiency in verbal and written communication in both English and French is required for this role.
- Being a member in good standing of the Ordre des Ingénieurs du Québec (OIQ), a CPI (Candidate to the engineering profession), or eligible for OIQ membership.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter
- The successful candidate currently has the ability to obtain Reliability Status screening from a duly authorized department or agency of the Government of Canada.  This process includes but is not limited to:
  - Verification of identity, background, education, professional credentials, personal and professional references, credit check and criminal background check.

**Reference Number:** R2876172

**Position Title:** 2027 Digital Graduate Program, Product Analyst, Data and AI Engineer

**Department:** Platform Engineering

**Location:** Toronto, ON

**Grade:** L2-1

**About the job**

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

  

Join Sanofi’s Data & AI platform engineering team and play a key role in advancing analytics, AI, and ML initiatives that shape the future of healthcare. As a Data & AI Engineer, you’ll design and deliver scalable solutions, and collaborate closely with leadership and teams to address both immediate and long-term business needs. Enjoy opportunities to learn from experts across technical and business domains, and drive impactful, data-driven innovation.

  

**About Sanofi**

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.​

  

We are Sanofi, an innovative global healthcare company that chases the miracles of science to improve people's lives. As an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma leader, we work across 100 countries to transform the practice of medicine by turning the impossible into the possible. Our expertise spans vaccines, rare diseases, rare blood disorders, neurology, immunology, oncology, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. Guided by our core values - Aim Higher, Act for Patients, Be Bold, and Lead Together - we provide life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions globally while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

  

**Main responsibilities:**

- Design, develop, and maintain Data and AI platform engineering solutions based on business requirements and design specifications using appropriate tools and technologies.
- Build, deploy Data and AI pipeline using LLMs and Embedding model from Bedrock and Snowflake Cortex (prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agents, and foundation model customization) and Snowflake Cortex functions (e.g., complete, summarize, embed\_text, Cortex Search/Analyst) and Snowflake with responsible AI guardrails, and continuously monitor model performance, data and concept drift, and inference and compute costs (token usage), optimizing pipelines and models accordingly.
- Partner with business, data engineering, and platform teams to identify high-value AI use cases and take them from ideation to production, mentor teams on best practices, and stay current on emerging AI/ML tools to accelerate time-to-value.
- Ensure developed solutions meet functional and technical requirements through rigorous testing and validation.
- Design, build, and maintain robust data and AI pipeline on AWS and Snowflake Cloud in support of our data mesh architecture.
- Work closely with global teams across North America, Europe, and India to align with data governance strategies and implement metadata management solutions.
- Ensure data security, compliance, and governance at every stage of the data platform, following global standards and best practices.
- Develop foundational knowledge in implementing data warehouses, data lakes, and distributed processing technologies such as Spark, Hadoop, and Kafka in production environments.
- Develop advanced proficiency with SQL (preferably Snowflake) and both relational and non-relational databases to optimize complex queries and data manipulation.
- Develop mastery in programming languages (like Python, Shell scripting, and Scala/Java) for the development of sophisticated data and AI engineering solutions.
- Work within cross-functional agile teams to contribute to the architecture and deployment of hybrid-cloud solutions and automated pipelines, ensuring seamless and high-performance data processing.
- Engage actively within the data and AI engineering community by sharing insights, best practices, and innovations that contribute to broader industry progress.

  

**About you**

You are enthusiastic about building your skills as a data or cloud engineer and eager to contribute to impactful projects. You have some experience with back-end or front-end technologies and a strong interest in developing reliable, practical solutions. You enjoy learning new things, working with others, and are motivated to help the team succeed. With a collaborative spirit and a desire to grow, you communicate clearly and are always ready to take on new challenges alongside experienced colleagues.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

- Must have participated in the Sanofi Co-Op program at some point during 2025 or 2026 and be eligible for a May 2027 start date.
- Must be legally authorized to work for Sanofi in Canada.

- Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
- Strong technical proficiency in data warehouse ecosystems (e.g., Snowflake).
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and familiarity with distributed systems, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture.
- Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLM technologies (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or similar foundation model platforms), including prompt engineering and model fine-tuning/customization.
- 1+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, with advanced skills in SQL and programming languages like Python.
- Proven ability to solve complex business problems using data modeling and statistical analysis techniques.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Solid understanding of data governance, including data quality, integration, and security.
- Knowledge of data protection regulations and best practices (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira.
- Business knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry is a plus.
- Experience in building AI platforms or contributing to data science projects is preferred.

  

**Nice to Have:**

- Experience in the life sciences/pharmaceutical industry.
- Familiarity with Data Mesh concepts such as data as a product, Understanding of Data Management principles, data governance best practices
- Proficiency in at least one Metadata Management Tool (Collibra or Informatica)

  

If you are a Data or Cloud Engineer looking for an exciting opportunity to shape the future of healthcare through data-driven insights and transformative solutions, we encourage you to apply for this key position. Join us in making a significant impact on the lives of global patients and customers through innovative data engineering solutions. We look forward to hearing from you!
